exposure: number of children in the household
outcome: Prevalence of allergic diseases (allergic rhinitis, urticaria, food allergy, drug allergy)
cohort: 10,464 primary school children aged 6-11 years in Shanghai, China
finding: Longer breastfeeding duration was associated with a lower risk of childhood asthma and allergic diseases, and attenuated the risk associated with other neonatal and familial factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with increased odds of childhood asthma and allergic diseases compared to vaginal delivery.
